children: China construction contractor's interim revenue for H1 2026 fell 41.84% yr/yr
Net profit for H1 2026 dropped 99.94% yr/yr
Company attributed declines to lower new contract values, down 51.55% yr/yr
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
CONTRACTING REVENUE DECLINE – Revenue fell RMB3.3 bln as completed projects and fewer, lower-value new contracts cut construction revenue by RMB3.21 bln
COST CONTROLS – Cost-control policy reduced G&A expenses by RMB29.96 mln and R&D costs by RMB5.29 mln
The stock recently traded at 1 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 1 three months ago
